skim: A 3-year-old girl and a 75-year-old man were pulled alive from Colombia’s earthquake rubble after more than 100 hours, as Indonesia’s Flores Island quake toll climbs to 51 and Zambia’s vote count resumes after ballot theft and a polling agent’s killing.

Stripe is reportedly buying AI-routing startup OpenRouter for over $7 billion — five times its May valuation — as Anthropic’s Dario Amodei calls the industry’s public backlash ‘fundamentally a crisis of trust.’

Ukraine hit Moscow with one of its largest drone barrages of the war as a NATO jet downed a Russian drone over Romania — the fourth such incursion this year — and Kushner held rare direct talks with Hamas’s chief in Cairo.
Modi’s NSA Ajit Doval revealed the PM’s vow after Pahalgam to hunt terrorists ‘on earth, in the sky or in hell,’ as Chamoli’s tunnel toll holds at eight with two workers still missing.
September Fed rate-hike odds have collapsed to 25% and gold holds near $4,400, while Oracle plans fresh layoffs even as it lifts AI data-centre capex guidance to $55.7 billion.

stories.headline: Colombia Earthquake: Girl, 3, and Man, 75, Pulled Alive From Rubble After 100 Hours
stories.body: A three-year-old girl and a 75-year-old man were rescued alive from the rubble of Colombia’s magnitude-7.4 earthquake more than 100 hours after it struck — well past the 72-hour window rescuers typically rely on — per Al Jazeera (Aug 16). Search teams say 320 people remain unaccounted for as recovery operations continue in hard-hit Cali and Buenaventura.

stories.headline: Indonesia Earthquake Death Toll Climbs to 51 as Thousands Are Displaced
stories.body: The death toll from the magnitude-7.7 earthquake that struck off Indonesia’s Flores Island rose to at least 51, with about 5,000 people evacuated and more than 1,300 homes damaged, per Al Jazeera (Aug 16). “The quake was massive, the shock was so strong… there were 13 of us inside the house, and we all ran to save ourselves,” said Nona, a 51-year-old resident of Talibura village, per Reuters.

stories.headline: Zambia Vote Count Resumes After Violence, Ballot Theft Suspend Tallying
stories.body: Vote counting in Zambia’s presidential election was briefly suspended after reports of ballot theft and violence, including the killing of a 57-year-old polling agent, before resuming once the electoral commission contained the “security threat,” per Al Jazeera (Aug 16). Partial results from 49 of 226 constituencies show incumbent Hakainde Hichilema leading with 52.6% to challenger Mundubile’s 42.1%, amid observer reports of intimidation and abductions across five provinces. European Parliament observer Reinhold Lopatka said, “Even one loss of life is one too many.”

stories.headline: Deadly Flash Flooding Hits US State of Indiana, at Least Five Dead
stories.body: At least five people died after storms dumped more than 280mm (11 inches) of rain over two days in Indiana, sending the White River over its banks in Indianapolis in what Mayor Joe Hogsett called the worst flooding in over 30 years, per Al Jazeera (Aug 15). The dead include a 58-year-old woman who drove into floodwaters and a 4-year-old struck by a falling tree, as Governor Mike Braun urged residents to “continue to take flooding seriously and stay away from floodwaters.”

stories.headline: Europe’s Rivers Hit Record Lows as Drought Grips Half the Continent
stories.body: New satellite imagery shows roughly half of Europe’s land is now in drought, with 9% of areas at alert level, as the Loire, Po, Rhine and Danube rivers all hit record-low levels this month, per Al Jazeera (Aug 16), citing the EU’s Global Drought Observatory. The European Commission’s Joint Research Centre confirmed the Loire reached record lows in August, following the hottest June-July on record for Western Europe.

stories.headline: Padikkal's Maiden Century Puts India in Command at Galle
stories.body: India closed day two on 460 for 9, powered by Devdutt Padikkal’s career-best 167 — his maiden Test century, made from No. 3 — with support from KL Rahul (82) and Dhruv Jurel (51), per ESPNcricinfo (Aug 16). Left-arm spinner Prabath Jayasuriya took 4 wickets as turn began creeping into the Galle surface, and with an 83% chance of rain forecast for day three, per Prokerala (Aug 16), India’s bowlers face a race against the weather in the five-day Test running through Aug 19.

stories.headline: Manchester Super Giants Win Maiden Hundred Title in Lord's Thriller
stories.body: Tim Seifert blitzed 72 off 38 balls — the fastest fifty in a men’s Hundred final, reached in 24 deliveries — to power Manchester Super Giants to a five-wicket win over Trent Rockets, chasing down 158 as Liam Dawson struck the winning six with three balls left, per Sky Sports (Aug 16). Captain Jos Buttler called it a ‘mixture of emotions’ after the tense finish, while earlier at Lord’s, Trent Rockets claimed the women’s title, bowling out SunRisers Leeds for just 91 as Kim Garth took two wickets in three balls.

stories.headline: Barcelona Agree €76.5m Deal With Man City for Rodri
stories.body: Barcelona and Manchester City have struck a deal worth roughly €76.5m ($87m) for World Cup-winning captain Rodri, capping a chase that had run past a 48-hour deadline, per beIN Sports and ESPN (Aug 16). A Barcelona source said ‘in the coming days there will be a statement and (the transfer) will become official,’ with the move partly driven by Frenkie de Jong’s expected multi-month injury lay-off; Rodri, 30, would follow Anthony Gordon and Karim Adeyemi to Camp Nou this summer.

stories.headline: Verstappen Chases Home Win at Zandvoort Amid Longest Drought
stories.body: Max Verstappen returns from F1’s summer break leading the drivers’ championship by 78 points with 10 rounds remaining, but arrives at his home Dutch Grand Prix winless since Spain on Jun 23 — his longest drought in four years — with just one podium since, per Reuters via Flashscore (Aug 17). Mercedes has won three of the last four races, with Lewis Hamilton taking two of the last three, while McLaren has closed to within 42 points of Red Bull in the constructors’ standings; Verstappen makes his 200th F1 start at Zandvoort on Aug 23, calling it ‘always a fantastic atmosphere’ for the home fans.

stories.headline: Romero Vows to 'Write My Name' Into Atletico History
stories.body: Cristian Romero was officially unveiled by Atletico Madrid after his €40m (£34.2m) move from Tottenham on a five-year deal through 2031, per Goal.com (Aug 15). ‘I know the only way is by winning trophies, so I come with that mentality and I will give everything until the last day to achieve it,’ the Argentina defender said, adding that the club’s style ‘fits me perfectly.’

stories.headline: Japan's Q2 Growth Badly Misses Forecasts, Complicating BOJ Timeline
stories.body: Japan’s economy expanded just 0.3% quarter-on-quarter (1.1% annualized) in Q2, far under the 2.0% forecast and down from 1.9% growth in Q1, as capital expenditure contracted 1.2% and private consumption stayed flat, per InvestingLive (Aug 16). The miss complicates the Bank of Japan’s rate-hike path even as inflation runs at 2.6% y/y, and Asian markets opened cautiously Monday — the Nikkei up just 0.13%, Hang Seng futures up 0.6%, and Korea’s Kospi closed for a holiday — with the yen near 159.24 per dollar and traders awaiting China’s retail sales and industrial output data, per CNBC-TV18/TradingView (Aug 17).

stories.headline: US Retail Sales Post Steepest Drop in a Year as Consumers Show Fatigue
stories.body: US retail sales fell 0.6% in July to $763.6 billion, with online sales tumbling 2.2% and auto sales down 1.8% — the steepest monthly drop in over a year, per The Korea Times (Aug 15). The University of Michigan’s consumer sentiment gauge slid roughly 8% in August as inflation expectations rose to 4.3%, prompting Navy Federal Credit Union’s chief economist to say “American consumers are showing signs of fatigue—July retail sales were disappointing on all levels.”

stories.headline: September Fed Rate-Hike Odds Plunge to 25% After Cooler Inflation Data
stories.body: Wall Street odds of a Fed rate hike at the September FOMC meeting collapsed to 25% from 60% in early August, after June CPI fell 0.4% and July CPI rose just 0.1%, per 24/7 Wall St (Aug 16). But the Cleveland Fed’s core PCE model still shows inflation running at 3.3%, well above target, with gasoline prices up 27-38% year-over-year, leaving three more inflation reports before the FOMC meeting that could yet revive hike bets under new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh.

stories.headline: Gold Holds Near $4,400 as Rate-Hike Fears Fade, Silver Tops $67
stories.body: Spot gold traded around $4,394/oz Monday, up 9.6% over the past month and 32% year-on-year, after cooling US CPI data pushed futures briefly toward $4,500 last week, per TradingEconomics (Aug 17) and Intellectia (Aug 13). Silver has outperformed, surging past $67/oz, with persistent central-bank buying — particularly from China — and Fed rate-hike odds sliding to 25% continuing to support safe-haven demand.

stories.headline: Brent Holds Near $89 as Hormuz Tanker Traffic Stays Crippled
stories.body: Brent crude traded at $88.58/barrel Monday, roughly 33% higher than a year ago, with Strait of Hormuz transits still running at only about 10 vessels a day versus roughly 130 before the US-Israel-Iran war, per TradingEconomics (Aug 17) and Al Jazeera (Aug 12). “Markets have not completely lost hope for a deal, but confidence is clearly eroding,” one analyst told Al Jazeera, as Houthi attacks on shipping and stalled reopening talks keep a war-risk premium baked into prices.

stories.headline: Stripe reportedly to acquire AI gateway startup OpenRouter for over $7 billion
stories.body: Stripe is in talks to buy OpenRouter, which lets developers route requests across 400-plus AI models and claims 8 million users, per TechCrunch (Aug 16). The deal values OpenRouter far above the $1.3 billion mark it hit in a May Series B; a Stripe spokesperson declined to comment on the “rumors or speculation.”

stories.headline: DeepSeek’s steep API price hikes take effect
stories.body: DeepSeek’s new pricing for V4-Flash and V4-Pro kicked in Aug 16 at 16:00 UTC, replacing its flat-rate model with peak and off-peak billing that raises costs by 50% to over 1,100% depending on usage, per Quartz (Aug 13). The shift marks the end of the aggressive price war DeepSeek itself helped start in the API market.

stories.headline: Anthropic’s Amodei says AI backlash is ‘a crisis of trust’
stories.body: Responding to investor criticism that his own warnings fueled anti-AI sentiment, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei said “I think it is fundamentally a crisis of trust,” per TechCrunch (Aug 16). He argued that “ordinary people don’t trust companies, governments, or the tech industry” and conceded AI firms, including Anthropic, have “not yet delivered on our big promises to benefit the world.”

stories.headline: Zuckerberg’s AI manifesto meets public skepticism
stories.body: Days after Mark Zuckerberg’s 6,500-word manifesto promising personal AI agents that “understand you, your goals, and everything you care about,” analysts say the pitch isn’t landing, per TechCrunch (Aug 16). Commentators noted the messenger problem given Meta’s social-media legacy of “ragebaiting and advertisements, not connection,” and pointed out Meta’s flagship Glimmer and Muse Spark products require specific hardware, undercutting the “for everyone” framing.

stories.headline: Anthropic IPO chatter escalates from $2 trillion to $3 trillion
stories.body: Just days after reports of a $2 trillion October IPO target, some investors are now floating $3 trillion, arguing that at “the incredibly low end” Anthropic’s growth justifies “30 times revenue… $3 trillion isn’t just defensible, it’s cheap,” per The Irish Times (Aug 15). Investors now expect Anthropic’s revenue run-rate to hit $100-120 billion by year-end, up from $47 billion in June, with valuations increasingly pegged to revenue multiples rather than profit.

stories.headline: Ukraine Pounds Moscow With Record Drone Barrage as NATO Downs Russian Drone Over Romania
stories.body: Ukraine launched one of its largest drone attacks of the war on Moscow, with Russia’s defence ministry claiming it downed 822 drones nationwide overnight while Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said 201 were destroyed over the capital region alone, per Al Jazeera (Aug 16). Russia’s retaliatory missile strikes killed a woman in Kryvyi Rih, while a Spanish F-18 on NATO air-policing duty shot down what alliance spokesman Martin O’Donnell called a drone that ‘appears to be Russian’ over Romania — the fourth such incursion into Romanian airspace this year.

stories.headline: Kushner Holds Rare Direct Talks With Hamas Chief in Cairo Ahead of Netanyahu Meeting
stories.body: Jared Kushner met Hamas leader Khalil al-Hayya in Cairo on Sunday, a rare direct US-Hamas contact aimed at reviving the stalled 15-point Gaza plan, per NPR (Aug 16). A Hamas official said the group is ‘committed and waiting for mediators to start the 14-day negotiation period,’ though it is still tying full disarmament to a path toward Palestinian statehood; Kushner, Tony Blair and Board of Peace director Nickolay Mladenov are due to meet Netanyahu Monday to press implementation.

stories.headline: Iran Ties Hormuz Reopening to US Compliance as Israel Hits Lebanon in Deadliest Strikes Since Truce
stories.body: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Tehran is ‘continuing talks with Oman on shipping routes’ through the Strait of Hormuz but that any reopening still hinges on Washington honoring June’s memorandum of understanding, per Al Jazeera (Aug 16). Separately, Israeli strikes on Lebanon killed at least 11 people, the deadliest single episode since the June ceasefire with Hezbollah took effect.

stories.headline: Venezuela’s Interim Government Frees 131 Political Prisoners in US-Brokered Reconciliation Push
stories.body: Venezuela’s transitional government released 131 people classified as political prisoners on Aug 14 under a ‘Program for Peace and Democratic Coexistence,’ part of talks brokered since Nicolás Maduro’s ouster in January, per Al Jazeera (Aug 15). US Secretary of State Marco Rubio called the releases ‘a crucial step for the nation’s reconciliation process,’ though opposition figure Juan Pablo Guanipa said roughly 391 political prisoners remained held as of Aug 10 and demanded their release ‘without exception, without delay.’

stories.headline: RSF Seizes Parts of Blue Nile’s Geisan as Sudan’s War Widens Into New Fronts
stories.body: RSF fighters and allied SPLM-N forces stormed Geisan in Blue Nile state with artillery and drones, capturing the main market before Sudan’s army beat back some advances with its own strikes, per Sudan Tribune (Aug 11). The UN’s OCHA reported roughly 2,500 people displaced by the fighting and renewed its call on ‘all parties to protect civilians and civilian infrastructure, and to allow aid to reach people quickly, safely and without obstruction,’ per UN News (Aug 12), as this year’s $3bn Sudan aid appeal remains only 41% funded.

fixtures.headline: Galle Test Enters Final Days, Colombo Test Looms
fixtures.body: The rain-hit 1st Test at Galle runs through Aug 19, with India’s bowlers needing to force a result on a pitch offering turn; the two-match series then shifts to the Sinhalese Sports Club in Colombo for the 2nd Test.

fixtures.headline: Premier League 2026/27 Kicks Off
fixtures.body: Arsenal open their title defence at home to Coventry City on Friday night, before Newcastle host Liverpool and Manchester City face Bournemouth over the weekend — six matches air live on Sky Sports across the opening round.

fixtures.headline: F1 Returns With Verstappen's Home Race
fixtures.body: Formula 1 resumes after its summer break at Zandvoort, where Max Verstappen — leading by 78 points but winless since June — makes his 200th career start in front of his home crowd.

fixtures.headline: Rodri's Barcelona Unveiling Expected
fixtures.body: With City and Barcelona having agreed a fee, an official announcement and unveiling of Rodri as a Barcelona player is expected within days, as the World Cup winner prepares to link up with Lamine Yamal and Pedri.

portfolio.headline: Cloudflare lifts revenue guidance on AI-traffic milestone, then prices $2.175bn convertible notes
portfolio.body: Cloudflare's second-quarter revenue rose 36% year-over-year to $696.1 million, prompting management to raise full-year guidance to a range of $2.86 billion to $2.87 billion, per Investing.com (Aug 10). The company also said non-human, machine-to-machine AI traffic has now crossed 50% of everything moving across its network, a milestone it points to as validating its push into agentic AI infrastructure. Days later Cloudflare priced a $2.175 billion convertible debt offering, with options for up to $2.5 billion, to fund further expansion — a raise several analysts, including Goldman Sachs, Wells Fargo, TD Cowen and UBS, treated as dilutive even as they lifted their price targets.

portfolio.headline: Oracle plans fresh layoffs as AI data-centre capex balloons to $55.7bn
portfolio.body: Oracle is preparing another round of job cuts this month, with some teams facing double-digit percentage reductions, as it manages the financial strain of its AI data-centre build-out, per Yahoo Finance (Aug 12). The cuts follow a prior fiscal year in which about 21,000 employees — 13% of the workforce — were let go, leaving headcount near 141,000; the company has already booked $1.8 billion in restructuring charges and expects up to $2.1 billion. Fiscal 2026 capital-expenditure guidance has been raised to $55.7 billion from an earlier $21.2 billion estimate as Oracle borrows heavily to finance the data-centre capacity it is building for AI customers.

portfolio.headline: Twilio posts record $1.5bn quarter and lifts full-year growth outlook to 18%
portfolio.body: Twilio reported second-quarter revenue of $1.499 billion, up 22% year-over-year and a company record, with non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $1.47, per its Aug 6 results (via The Motley Fool, Aug 9). Organic growth accelerated to 17% from 16% in the prior quarter, and management raised full-year guidance for reported revenue growth to 18-18.5% and organic growth to 13-13.5%, up from a prior 9.5-10.5% organic outlook. Dollar-based net expansion reached 116%, meaning existing customers grew their spend at a double-digit clip even before counting new logos.

portfolio.headline: CrowdStrike investors trim positions ahead of Aug 26 earnings amid stretched valuation
portfolio.body: CrowdStrike saw elevated volatility this week as profit-taking swept through high-multiple growth software names ahead of the company's Aug 26 quarterly report, per TradingKey (Aug 14). Its price-to-sales ratio has expanded well above historical norms even as Wall Street holds an average price target of $193.61, and the report flagged heavy insider selling in recent months running alongside continued buying from quantitative funds. The activity looks like positioning into the print rather than a reaction to any new disclosure from the company itself.

portfolio.headline: Beyond Meat completes 1-for-30 reverse split days after swinging back to profit and hiring a new COO
portfolio.body: Beyond Meat's 1-for-30 reverse stock split took effect at 11:59pm ET on Aug 13, consolidating every 30 shares into one and cutting authorized shares from 3 billion to 100 million, a move the company says is meant to help it regain compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid-price rule ahead of an Aug 31 deadline, per its GlobeNewswire release. The reset followed second-quarter results in which Beyond Meat posted sales of $68.83 million and swung to net income of $16.4 million, alongside the appointment of food-industry veteran Brijesh Krishnaswamy as chief operating officer and founder Ethan Brown's return to the board, per Yahoo Finance (Aug 9). Management guided third-quarter net revenue to $60-65 million.

portfolio.headline: Sensus Healthcare revenue falls 68% as unit sales slow, though 8 shipped units await financing sign-off
portfolio.body: Sensus Healthcare reported second-quarter revenue of $2.3 million, down from $7.3 million a year earlier, as unit shipments fell to 11 from 19, per its Aug 13 results (via StockTitan). Gross margin narrowed to 34.8% from 39.7%, and the company posted a net loss of $8.7 million, or $0.53 per share, versus a $1.0 million loss in the year-ago quarter, with negative adjusted EBITDA of $3.0 million. Management said eight units already shipped but pending financing approval should be recognized as revenue in the third quarter, and the company ended the period with $15.2 million in cash and no debt.

portfolio.headline: Hydrofarm stays volatile in the wake of its $16m Aurora Peat divestiture
portfolio.body: Hydrofarm Holdings completed the sale of its Aurora Peat Products division to Raven Holdings for $16 million, including a $5 million promissory note, with proceeds earmarked to pay down term-loan debt, per StocksToTrade (Aug 5). The company retained a long-term supply and distribution relationship with the divested unit and launched ‘Project Agility,’ a pivot toward an asset-light logistics and controlled-environment-agriculture services model. No fresh company-specific announcement was found for the session; as a thinly traded micro-cap, the stock has continued to swing sharply in the weeks since the divestiture rather than on any new news today.

stories.headline: Doval reveals Modi's vow after Pahalgam: 'We will not forgive'
stories.body: In an upcoming Discovery docuseries, "Declassified: Operation Sindoor," National Security Advisor Ajit Doval revealed PM Modi’s reaction after the Pahalgam terror attack, quoting him as saying, “We will go after them… whether they are on earth, in the sky or in hell, wherever they are. We will not forgive them,” per WION (Aug 16). Doval added that Operation Sindoor’s message was that India’s fight against terror continues “till the last terrorist is eliminated,” and that Pakistan needed to understand that supporting terrorism was intolerable to India.

stories.headline: Chamoli tunnel toll holds at 8 as inquiry ordered, two still missing
stories.body: Search operations for two workers — Lucas Topno of Jharkhand and Chetan Poyam of Chhattisgarh — entered a fourth day at the flooded THDC tunnel in Pipalkoti, Chamoli, with the toll steady at eight dead and twelve injured already rescued, per ThePrint (Aug 16). District Magistrate Gaurav Kumar has ordered a magisterial inquiry into the causes of the Aug 13 landslide that flooded the tunnel, as NDRF, SDRF and ITBP teams keep pumping out water to reach the trapped men.

stories.headline: Jharkhand students vow August 20 gherao of CM Soren's residence
stories.body: Marking the 23rd day of their agitation over alleged JPSC-JSSC exam irregularities, protesting students said they will gherao Chief Minister Hemant Soren’s residence on Aug 20 and burn effigies of Soren and Congress leader Rahul Gandhi at 24 district headquarters, per WION (Aug 16). “We seek his resignation as both the JMM and the Congress are playing politics with us,” said Ravindra Paswan of the JPSC-JSSC Reforms Manch, as the state government cancelled three exams and brought in the Enforcement Directorate but resisted handing the case to the CBI.

stories.headline: Reform Unveils £50bn Welfare Overhaul Targeting PIP
stories.body: Reform UK will publish a 50-page welfare blueprint on Monday proposing £50bn in annual savings by scrapping PIP and the Universal Credit health element for working-age adults, changes that would hit 2.89 million of the UK’s 6.9 million disability benefit claimants, per Yahoo News (Aug 16). Treasury spokesman Robert Jenrick said “dumping our young people onto welfare isn’t compassion; it’s neglect,” while Labour branded the costings “fantasy economics” and the Conservatives accused Reform of trying to “distract attention” from the party’s ongoing donations probe.

stories.headline: Stourbridge Families Return Home as Wildfire Cordons Lift
stories.body: Three days after wildfires tore through Stourbridge in the West Midlands, fire crews significantly lifted cordons, letting eight families view homes destroyed in the blaze and 13 more households with partial damage return, alongside 85 evacuated households whose properties were unaffected, per Express & Star (Aug 16). Dudley council chief executive Balvinder Heran urged residents not to speculate about the fire’s cause while investigations continue, as community fundraising for affected families topped £125,000.

stories.headline: Energy Bills Set to Reignite UK Cost-of-Living Squeeze
stories.body: UK inflation is forecast to climb to 2.9% in July, up from 2.6%, after household energy price caps rose 13%, with the Bank of England warning headline inflation could hit 3.2% by year-end or as high as 4.5% by mid-2027 if Middle East tensions escalate, per The British Eye (Aug 16). RSM UK chief economist Thomas Pugh said “the cost of living squeeze is set to return to the headlines,” even as a government VAT cut due in October is expected to trim average electricity bills by about £45 a year.

stories.headline: Qatar PM, Saudi FM Discuss Hormuz De-escalation
stories.body: Qatar’s Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al-Thani held a phone call with Saudi Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan, stressing “the importance of all parties committing to dialogue and diplomacy” on implementing the US–Iran memorandum of understanding and preserving freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, per The Peninsula Qatar (Aug 16). The call came the same evening as separate Qatari calls with the foreign ministers of Jordan and Syria on de-escalating regional tensions.

stories.headline: Qatar Joins 8 Nations Condemning Israel’s Gaza Roadmap Rejection
stories.body: Qatar and the foreign ministers of seven other Arab and Islamic states — including Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Jordan, Egypt, Turkey, Pakistan and Indonesia — issued a joint statement condemning Israel’s rejection of a roadmap to implement the US-backed Gaza peace plan under UN Security Council Resolution 2803, per The Peninsula Qatar (Aug 16). The ministers said “Israel now bears responsibility for obstructing the efforts to bring peace in Gaza” and reaffirmed calls for a two-state solution based on 1967 borders with East Jerusalem as its capital.

stories.headline: Iran Demands Qatar Allow Pilot Investigators
stories.body: Iran formally asked Qatar to admit an air force fact-finding team to probe the fate of three fighter pilots missing since Doha downed two Iranian jets on Mar 2, with military official Mohammad Bagherzadeh saying the unit has “been waiting for months for permission to enter Qatar,” per Middle East Monitor (Aug 16). The request follows Qatar’s Aug 15 denial that it is detaining any Iranian pilots, deepening a diplomatic rift that has also drawn in Kuwait over four additional detained Iranians.

doha_events.headline: Colorverse Experience Continues at Katara
doha_events.body: This immersive family exhibition blending colour, light, sound and interactive challenges runs at Katara South Parking, Katara Cultural Village, through Sep 15, open 4pm–10pm on weekdays and until 11pm on weekends, per Platinumlist (Aug 17). Tickets start at QAR 35 for the roughly 35-minute journey through seven interactive zones designed to “restore the primary RGB colors.”

doha_events.headline: Tasweer Marks World Photography Day at Fire Station
doha_events.body: Tasweer hosts “Together in Photography: World Photography Day” at Fire Station Cinema on Aug 19 from 6:30pm–8:30pm, unveiling the winners of the 2026 Tasweer Awards, per Gulf Times (Aug 12). The evening also explores photography’s role in preserving memory and will be live-streamed on Tasweer’s digital platforms for international audiences.

doha_events.headline: PAW Patrol: The Big Show Rescue Hits Qatar Mall
doha_events.body: A free family stage show brings Nickelodeon’s PAW Patrol characters to the Oasis Stage at Qatar Mall from Aug 20–29, per Qatar Living’s weekly roundup (Aug 16). It’s one of several family-friendly picks in this week’s “events to check out” list alongside museum activities and workshops around Doha.
